newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Consortium to invest S$115 mln in S'pore network.
newsitem.headline: Consortium to invest S$115 mln in S'pore network.

text.p: The Singapore government said on Thursday a group of 17 technology companies and institutions would invest a total of Singapore $115 million in its broadband telecommunications network "Singapore ONE".
An official of Singapore's National Science and Technology Board told a news conference the companies would spend the money on research and development (R&D).
The Singapore government has so far commited S$154 million to build Singapore ONE, an ambitious scheme to link the whole of Singapore on one high-capacity telecommunications cable system.
The network will be able to deliver to every Singapore home high-quality multi-media services such as films, interactive video-conferencing and the Internet.
The 17 companies signed a memorandum of understanding on Thursday, agreeing to conduct R&D on the project.
The consortium includes units of Ericsson, IBM, Philips and JVC.
